name: rate-limited-then-success
why: A 429 — never billed, so the reservation is voided and a fresh one is taken for the retry.

provenance.why_not_recorded: Forcing a 429 means deliberately hammering a live service until it sheds load. That is abuse of the API, not measurement, and the repo will not do it to obtain a fixture.
